name: teamtracker
description: TeamTracker — employee time tracking and admin dashboard

scripts.build:admin: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -C admin run build
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -C desktop run build
scripts.typecheck:admin: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -C admin run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:desktop: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -C desktop exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run typecheck:shared && pnpm -C admin run typecheck && pnpm -C desktop run ensure-shared && pnpm -C desktop exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:desktop-admin
scripts.test: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -C admin run test && pnpm -C desktop run test
scripts.test:admin: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -C admin run test
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -C desktop run test
scripts.test-all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build:desktop && pnpm run build:desktop-admin && pnpm run build:admin
